request.query: A coefficient of the difference of two multivariate polynomials equals the difference of coefficients and the degree of the difference is bounded by the maximum

items.name: Polynomial.degree_sub_le_of_le
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] {p q : Polynomial R} {a b : WithBot ℕ},
  p.degree ≤ a → q.degree ≤ b → (p - q).degree ≤ max a b

items.name: Polynomial.coeff_sub
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] (p q : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ), (p - q).coeff n = p.coeff n - q.coeff n

items.name: Polynomial.degree_sub_le
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] (p q : Polynomial R), (p - q).degree ≤ max p.degree q.degree

items.name: Polynomial.natDegree_sub_le
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] (p q : Polynomial R), (p - q).natDegree ≤ max p.natDegree q.natDegree

items.name: Polynomial.natDegree_sub_le_of_le
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {n m : ℕ} [inst : Ring R] {p q : Polynomial R},
  p.natDegree ≤ m → q.natDegree ≤ n → (p - q).natDegree ≤ max m n

items.name: MvPolynomial.totalDegree_sub
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (a b : MvPolynomial σ R),
  (a - b).totalDegree ≤ max a.totalDegree b.totalDegree
